about_the_game:
The Premise / Hook

In the world of immortal cultivation, do the legends of eternal life and ascension truly exist?

Here, cultivation is no longer a path to enlightenment; it's a job. The major sects, while ostensibly claiming to eliminate demons and protect the righteous, are in reality massive "corporations" that profit from the eradication of monsters. Disciples are merely tools of exploitation, trading endless missions for meager resources, while the Sect Masters and High Elders reap the rewards, transforming "immortality seeking" into an industry of exploitation and profit exchange.

The Gameplay / Features

Every adventure is shrouded in the unknown, and every battle is a test of your wit and your choices.

As a Roguelike Card Strategy game, it not only inherits the high randomness and deep strategy of the roguelike genre but also perfectly blends the unique allure of the Wuxia/Xianxia world with the survival struggles of a cultivator. Players will feel the arduous journey and difficult decisions of the cultivation path through card construction and combat.
